releases.title: Metal Fetishist v2.0-rc.1
release_notes: Added ability to play the instrument via MIDI.
Added alternative effects: Phaser, Flanger, Chorus.
Added alternative step-modulation destinations: Volume Decay Time, Pitch Decay Amount, CutOff Decay Amount, Volume, Effect Param.
Added alternative step sequencer lengths: 3, 5, 7, 12, 18 and 24.
Added the ability to disable sequencer auto-start when using external clock sources.
Added a sequencer option that enforces starting always from the first step.
NOTE: Please check the V2 Pre-release Documentation available for download at the Support & Resources page.

releases.title: Metal Fetishist v1.2
release_notes: Fixed an issue where MIDI input parser would crash with certain hardware and required a restart.

releases.title: Metal Fetishist v1.1
release_notes: Fixed MIDI clock sync so it defaults to a faster speed. Many of you asked for this!
Fixed an issue where the sequencer was not properly resetting the step cycle time when switching to Play mode.
Fixed an issue where the trigger button would stop working if the instrument was running for longer than a day.
Fixed cut-off control curve to remove dead space at lowest values.
Lowered cut-off envelope amount range to make the control curve more useful.
Added a clock multiplier (x2, x4, x8) for external clock inputs (MIDI and CV). This is the biggest change and we honestly believe you will love playing with it at faster settings.
